name: Reviewer
description: Reviews a change through a single reviewer: the review-<lens> common step, e.g. review-standards (unwritten conventions and judgement), review-specs (does it do what was asked, and no more), review-style (the written style guides) or review-security. The code-review common step runs several of these at once. Add a review-<name> common step to add a reviewer. Read-only; ends with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: CHANGES.

parameters.label: Reviewer
parameters.description: Which reviewer: the name of a review-<name> common step, e.g. standards, specs, style or security.

parameters.label: What to review
parameters.description: The work to review and where to find it.
parameters.default: the uncommitted changes for {{ticket.key}} (look at git status and git diff HEAD, and read any new untracked files)

parameters.label: What the change is meant to do
parameters.description: The ticket, requirements or specs to review against; templates such as {{steps.implement.output}} are fine.

parameters.label: Anything else to check
parameters.description: Extra instructions for this reviewer, e.g. what matters most for this kind of change.
